name: Standard Container 3m
description: A standard 3 m cargo container: three 3x3x3 m slots in a row, each a cradle a module stands on, and a hatch the whole length of each side that swings up to an awning. A crane's spreader takes it whole by its four top corner castings; it stands on its four bottom ones, and clamps at its feet lock it onto a container under it.

config.label: Width
config.tooltip: The hold's size across the container.

config.label: Centre y
config.tooltip: Where the hold's middle is (y: under the roof).

config.label: Material
config.tooltip: The bulk it holds. Creative worlds only.
